content: Ajeǧid Axazya ittwaneɣ s ufus n Yahu

Imezdaɣ n Urcalim ggin Axazya, mmis amaẓuẓ, d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes, maɣar marra aytmas imeqqranen tuɣa ttwanɣen zeg ict n bandiyya i tuɣa dd-tudef ak-d Weɛraben ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar. Ammu i idweř Axazya, mmis n Yahuram, d ajeǧid n Yahuda.
Axazya tuɣa ɣares tnayen u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa, umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem ijj n useggʷas di Urcalim. Yemmas qqaren as Ɛatalya, yeǧis n Ɛumri.
Netta yuyur deg ibriden n taddart n Axab, maɣar yemmas d tamcawart nnes di marra tuɛeffna i igga.
Netta igga min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, am taddart n Axab, maɣar awarni i řmewt n babas tuɣa inni n taddart n Axab d imcawaren nnes ařami ikka x uzeǧif.
Netta iḍfar ccwar nsen uca iffeɣ ak-d Yuram, mmis n Axab, ajeǧid n Israil, i umenɣi ak-d Ḥazayil, ajeǧid n Aram, ɣar Ramut di Jilɛad uca ayt n Aram ɣeřben x Yuram.

Xenni yareggʷeḥ maḥend ad yarzu di Yazraɛil agenfu zeg iyezzimen nni i d as tuɣa ggin ayt n Aram umi immneɣ di Ramut ak-d ujeǧid nsen, Ḥazayil, ajeǧid n Aram. Ihwa-dd Ɛazarya, mmis n Yahuram, ajeǧid n Yahuda, ɣar din, ḥima ad issijj x Yuram, mmis n Axab, di Yazraɛil, umi tuɣa ihřec.
Areddeǧ n Axazya tuɣa zi AREBBI umi dd-yusa ɣar Yuram. Umi dd-yiweḍ din, iffeɣ ak-d Yuram ɣar Yahu, mmis n Nimci, wenni tuɣa idhen SIDI, maḥend ad iqḍa x taddart n Axab.
Umi iqḍa Yahu řḥukm x taddart n Axab, imsar, aqa yufa řḥukkam n Yahuda d iḥenjiren n aytmas n Axazya, inni i tuɣa ittsexxaren i Axazya, uca inɣa i-ten.

Xenni yarzu x Axazya. Nitni ṭṭfen t am tuɣa innuffar di Samarya uca iwyen t ɣar Yahu. Nɣin t u neḍřen t, minzi nnan: “Netta d mmis n Yahucafaṭ, wenni yarezzun x SIDI s marra uř nnes.” Ammu war iqqim i taddart n Axazya uřa d ijj wenni di iǧa jjehd ḥima ad iḥkem am ujeǧid.
Yuwac war ittwaneɣ s ifassen n Atalya
Umi Ɛatalya, yemmas n Axazya teẓra, aqa mmis immut, tekkar, tᵉteḥḥa marra tarwa n ujeǧid n taddart n Yahuda.

Maca Yahuciba, yeǧis n ujeǧid, teksi Yuwac, mmis n Axazya, uca texḍef i-t zi jar iḥenjiren n ujeǧid nni ittwanɣen, uca tessidef i-t ak-d tenni t issuṭuḍen deg wexxam n tassut. Ammu i tegga Yahuciba, yeǧis n ujeǧid Yahuram, tamɣart n ukehhan Yahuyadaɛ - maɣar nettat d učmas n Axazya - tessnuffar i-t i Ɛatalya u tanita war t tenɣi ca.
Setta n iseggʷusa iqqim innuffar ɣarsen di Taddart n AREBBI u tuɣa Ɛatalya tḥekkem x temmurt.
